who: Historian of Africa at the University of Florida, PhD Cambridge.

who: John William Burgess, professor of political science and constitutional history at Columbia, 1876–1912.

who: Erwin Ramsdell Goodenough, Yale historian of religion, DPhil Oxford 1923.

evidence.says: Yale's archival biography records his Oxford DPhil in 1923, Yale history appointments beginning in 1923, and professorship in history of religion from 1934 to 1959. It identifies Jewish Symbols in the Greco-Roman Period as his major work.
Connects the forms Erwin R. Goodenough and Erwin Ramsdell Goodenough with Jewish Symbols in the Greco-Roman Period.
Identifies Erwin Ramsdell Goodenough as a scholar of the history of religion, also known as Erwin Goodenough.

notes: The full name, works, and Yale history appointment establish the candidate identity in 1937–1938. These sources do not independently verify each listed dissertation supervision.

who: George Alexander Lensen, historian of East Asian diplomatic relations at Florida State University.

The state archives identify a portrait of FSU history professor George A. Lensen under the full name George Alexander Lensen.
